<?php
$curl = curl_init();
curl_setopt_array($curl, [
    CURLOPT_URL => 'https://api.test/up',
    CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
    CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST => 'PUT',
    CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['X-A: 1'],
    CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => ['note' => 'hi', 'doc' => new CURLFile('./a.pdf', 'application/pdf')],
]);
$response = curl_exec($curl);
curl_close($curl);
echo $response;
